statusLine.command: jq -r --arg home "$HOME" 'def fmt: (. // 0) | if . >= 1000000 then "\((. / 100000 | floor) / 10)M" elif . >= 1000 then "\((. / 100 | floor) / 10)k" else "\(.)" end; def pct: if . == null then "-" else "\((. * 100) | round)%" end; ((.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // "") | if startswith($home) then "~" + .[($home | length):] else . end) as $cwd | (((.model | if type == "object" then (.display_name // .id) else . end) // "") | test("Claude|GPT"; "i")) as $is3p | ((.quota // {})[if $is3p then "3p-5h" else "gemini-5h" end].remaining_fraction | pct) as $q5h | ((.quota // {})[if $is3p then "3p-weekly" else "gemini-weekly" end].remaining_fraction | pct) as $qwk | (.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) as $tin | (.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0) as $tout | (($tin + $tout) | fmt) as $tot | (.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens | fmt) as $cur_in | (.context_window.context_window_size | fmt) as $ctx_sz | ((.context_window.used_percentage // 0) | round) as $ctx_pct | "\u001b[34m\($cwd)\u001b[0m | Ctx: \u001b[33m\($ctx_pct)%\u001b[0m (\($cur_in)/\($ctx_sz)) | 5h: \u001b[32m\($q5h)\u001b[0m | Week: \u001b[32m\($qwk)\u001b[0m | Tokens: \u001b[36m\($tot)\u001b[0m (in \($tin | fmt) / out \($tout | fmt))"'

title.command: t=""; id=""; s=""; p=""; pfx=""; eval "$(jq -r '@sh "t=\(.conversation_title // "") id=\(.conversation_id // "") s=\(.agent_state // "idle") p=\(.tool_confirmation_pending // false)"')"; if [ -z "$t" ] && [ -n "$id" ] && [ -r "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" ]; then t=$(jq -Rr 'capture("title:\\s*(?<q>\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\")").q | fromjson' "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ "$p" = true ] || [ "$s" = reviewing ] || [ "$s" = authenticating ]; then pfx="● "; elif [ "$s" = working ] || [ "$s" = tool_use ] || [ "$s" = initializing ] || [ "$s" = merging ]; then pfx="▶ "; fi; printf '%s%s\n' "$pfx" "${t:-agy}"
